verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs say Cloud Firestore keeps data in sync across client apps through realtime listeners, and that apps can listen to data even while offline, syncing changes on reconnect. Community reports back this up: one developer synced live whiteboard tile positions across multiple clients, and another added real-time notifications in about 5 hours. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the listener/subscription API (query-level listeners, change types, unsubscribe), plus recent hands-on corroboration specific to Firestore listeners rather than the original Firebase service.
